no_baseline_warning: No vanilla baseline: changes are shown without "before → after" and rows appear in full.
tools_missing: Missing binaries in tools/: %1. See tools/VERSIONS.md.
home_subtitle: Add mods (.pak, .zip or folder). Order sets the default priority: the first one wins.
home_dropzone: Drag a .pak / .zip / folder here, or use the buttons
home_import_baseline_tip: Folder with vanilla table JSONs (UAssetGUI/FModel dump)
changes_hint: Load mods and run "Analyze changes" on the Mods page.
conflicts_none: No conflicts between the loaded mods. 🎉
merge_output_note: Output: zzz_StellarTool_Merged_P (the zzz prefix guarantees load priority)
merge_nobaseline_note: No baseline: tables start from the highest-priority mod and selections are applied on top.
merge_zip_check: Also generate an installable .zip (Paks\ + readme, for Vortex or another mod manager)
settings_game_desc: Needed to read Zen/IoStore mods and build the vanilla baseline. Auto-detected from Steam if possible.
settings_game_none: Not set — Zen mods can't be read.
settings_mappings_desc: Used to read/write game assets. Ships with the tool. If the game was patched and you get "no produjo" / "no exportó" errors, load an updated StellarBlade.usmap here.
err_game_not_found: That folder doesn't look like a Stellar Blade install (SB/Content/Paks/global.utoc not found).
lang_popup_desc: You can change it later in Settings.
easy_subtitle: Drop all your mods here and merge everything against vanilla in one click. Conflicts are auto-resolved by order (the first mod wins).
easy_advanced_hint: Untick any change you don't want in the merge. Conflicts are resolved in favor of the first mod; use the Conflicts tab to change a winner.
easy_setup_banner: Stellar Blade folder not set: Zen mods (the usual Nexus format) can't be read and changes are shown without vanilla values.
mode_advanced_tip: Workbench for building a merge-mod: mod priority, per-change selection, manual conflict resolution, projects.
baseline_prompt_body: Without the baseline, changes are shown without "before → after", conflicts are less precise and rows appear in full. Building it from the game is recommended (takes a few minutes, only once).
baseline_prompt_body_stale: The game was updated after the baseline was built. Rebuilding it is recommended so changes and conflicts match the current version.
baseline_prompt_no_game: First set the Stellar Blade folder in Settings, then build the baseline.
conflicts_hint: Load mods and analyze to see conflicts here.
toml_export_empty: No selected scalar changes to export.
toml_import_read_fail: Could not read the TOML file.
toml_import_empty: No literal row/value patches found in that TOML.
bulk_desc: Apply an operation to all visible numeric changes. Narrow with the search box, and/or filter rows by a regex below.
edit_value_invalid: Invalid value for this property's type.
easy_disable_confirm: Move %1 source mod(s) from ~mods to ~mods\disabled\? Nothing is deleted; you can move them back anytime.
err_cue4_missing: cue4parse.exe not found in tools/. Run setup.bat. Needed to read Zen/IoStore mods.
err_need_game_path: To read Zen/IoStore mods, set your Stellar Blade folder in Settings (CUE4Parse needs the game's global container to resolve types).
err_need_usmap: Mappings (.usmap) missing. Without them CUE4Parse cannot resolve types and reading tables takes tens of minutes. Get them in Settings → Mappings (download or load your own), or put StellarBlade.usmap in tools/.
err_no_write_base: Couldn't get the vanilla version of %1 from the game, so there is no base to write the merged table on. Reason: %2
err_retoc_no_table: retoc could not extract %1 from the game containers (are the game files complete and up to date?).
err_table_not_in_game: %1 is not in the game containers.
err_zen_mod: '%1' is a Zen/IoStore mod (.ucas/.utoc) and could not be reverted to legacy (already-packed mod containers cannot always be unpacked). Use the legacy version of the mod: a classic .pak, or the folder with the .uasset files (e.g. the 'package' dir with SB/Content/...).
err_zen_mod_tables:
'%1' is a Zen/IoStore mod (.ucas/.utoc) that cannot be reverted to legacy, so its values can't be read for merging.

It modifies: %2.

To merge it, get the mod's legacy version (a classic .pak, or its source folder with the .uasset files under SB/Content/...).
err_zen_container: '%1' is a Zen/IoStore container that could not be reverted to legacy. Use the legacy version of the mod.
err_zip_empty: The zip contains neither .pak nor .uasset assets.
err_unsupported: Unsupported format: %1 (.pak, .zip or folder are accepted)
merge_ok_zip: OK: merged pak + installable zip generated and verified in %1.
merge_ok: OK: merged pak generated and verified in %1.
merge_skipped_note: (%1 array/object changes from Zen mods were skipped: those don't round-trip reliably yet. Numbers, text and enums are merged.)
builder_q_outfit: Skin Suit on shield break (needs helper)
builder_outfit_qte_alpha_hint: Confirmed in-game (2026-07-29): restores your outfit on shield break with no helper at all. Still untested with special story outfits.
builder_outfit_fix_hint: The outfit swap hijacks two vanilla effect rows. The camp rest visual is always restored; this also restores the 4s shield-regen lock after your shield breaks.
builder_out_in_mods: That folder is inside ~mods. The game loads it recursively, so the build's intermediate files would stay loaded as shadow mods that override the installed one. Pick a folder outside the game; the tool installs the pak into ~mods on its own.
builder_shadow_hint: The game loads ~mods recursively. These paks load but were not installed by this tool (usually left by a build compiled inside ~mods) and can override the installed mod. Delete them by hand.
builder_cancelled: Build cancelled. Previous install restored and partial output cleaned.
builder_game_missing: Game not detected — a ZIP will be generated for manual install
builder_game_prompt_body: Stellar Tool couldn't find your Stellar Blade install. Some options (hardcore enemies, difficulty scaling) need it to build. Pick the game folder — the one containing SB/Content/Paks.
builder_install_helper: Install and enable the helper (edits mods.txt)
builder_install_warn: Game files will be modified. Close Stellar Blade first.
reshade_desc: Save and switch ReShade presets. Stellar Tool stores its library in app data and backs up ReShade.ini before restoring a preset.
reshade_game_missing: Configure the Stellar Blade folder first.
reshade_backup_hint: A backup was created before the last restore:
reshade_save_failed: Could not save the active ReShade preset.
builder_uninstall_confirm: This removes what this tool installed from the game. Close Stellar Blade first.
builder_beta_note: Mini-boss improvements (anti-farm + difficulty) — BETA, validate in-game.
builder_q_variety: Enemy variety (elites + uniques in repetitive zones)
builder_ex_qol: Player QoL (high stacks, more shield-regen, attack speed)
builder_ex_gauge: Beta on perfect parry / Burst on perfect dodge (no skill tree)
builder_combat_changes_hint: Each option is a real Stellar Souls change. Combine them freely.
builder_combat_economy_full: Stellar Souls — slower gain, lower capacity and cooldown
builder_region_hint: Enable each region separately and set its density from 1% to 100%.
builder_ow_enable: Place roaming bosses in the open world
builder_ow_hint: Their own variants of the field bosses (the original encounters stay untouched). Reuses existing spawn points: no new placements.
builder_ex_beta_parry: Beta on perfect parry (no skill tree)
builder_ex_burst_dodge: Burst on perfect dodge (no skill tree)
builder_ex_base_attributes: Base attributes: 3000 HP, 1000 shield and 20% shield reduction
builder_ex_gauge_over_time: Sustained Beta/Burst recovery after perfect actions
builder_ex_drone_scan: Drone scan: 5 s cooldown, 10 s marking
builder_ex_gun_rotation: Allow rotation during the GunGorgon stance
builder_conflict_body: %1 cannot be combined with %2. Which one do you want to keep?
builder_advanced_selection_hint: Customize every grouped internal property separately.
builder_preset_empty: You have not saved any presets yet.
needs_analyze: %1 mod(s) loaded but not analyzed yet — run the analysis to see them here.
merge_dropped_note: %1 was left out of the merged pak: none of its changes could be written, so including it would have replaced that table with vanilla and overridden the mod it came from. Keep that mod enabled.
merge_failed_note: %1 was left out of the merged pak: the generated table did not pass verification, so it was excluded instead of shipping a corrupt file. Keep the mod that changes that table enabled, and please report the case with merge_report.txt.
update_available: Stellar Tool %1 is out. You are on %2.
builder_alpha_title: Restore outfit without CNS (vanilla test builds)
builder_alpha_warn: ALPHA — rougher than BETA: not confirmed in-game yet. Install ONE at a time.
builder_alpha_note: For players who do NOT use CNS (replacer outfits). Needs UE4SS, not CNS. It only acts when EVE keeps the Skin Suit mesh after the Skin Suit equipment is already gone (the boss-QTE case). Log: %USERPROFILE%\StellarSoulsVanillaRestore.log — Alt+R restore now, Alt+D diagnostics.
builder_alpha1: ALPHA1 probe — reads only, heartbeat + diagnostics (start here)
builder_alpha2: ALPHA2 meshrepaint — ApplyMeshInfo(); no cheat manager, no suit id
builder_alpha4: ALPHA4 cheatequip-construct — same, but builds its own cheat manager
builder_alpha5: ALPHA5 equiptoggle — unequip then re-equip (the manual fix, automated)
builder_alpha6: ALPHA6 chain — tries 2 → 3/4 → 5, stops at the first that repaints
builder_hardcore_note: Main: bosses x2 HP/x1.25 shield. Insane: x3 HP/x2 shield. Boss damage x1.25. Regular enemies are unchanged; Maelstrom is excluded.
builder_q_outfit_no_helper: Skin Suit on shield break (No Helper ALPHA)
builder_helper_nocns_hint: Uses the vanilla helper instead of the CNS one, with the ALPHA picked further down (alpha6 if you pick none).
builder_world_hint: Every value is a % of the vanilla value (100 = vanilla). They ship in their own pak, so they combine with any combat mod.
builder_preset_share_hint: Presets export as .stpreset files: hand your setup to someone else and let them build it with their own values.
err_preset_read: Could not read the preset file: %1
err_preset_write: Could not write the preset file: %1
err_preset_format: That file is not a Stellar Tool Builder preset.
err_preset_newer: This preset comes from a newer Stellar Tool. Update the app to import it.
err_oodle_missing: oo2core_9_win64.dll (Oodle) not found. CUE4Parse needs it and it is taken from your own Stellar Blade install (SB\Binaries\Win64) because its licence forbids shipping it. Pick the game folder in Settings, point Settings > Oodle at the DLL, or copy it next to the tool in tools\. Searched:
settings_oodle_desc: Needed to read and write the game's Zen/IoStore paks. It is never bundled (proprietary): it is read from your Stellar Blade install. Only set this if the tool cannot find it there.
settings_oodle_none: Not found. Pick the game folder above, or choose the DLL here.
save_desc: Converts Stellar Blade saves and mods to JSON for inspection or editing, and generates them again. Includes a repair for damaged CNS saves.
save_fix_hint: The repair removes AutoLoadCNS and CamPosition. An automatic backup is created in the Backup folder next to the save before overwriting it.
save_write_hint: When generating a save over an existing file, an automatic backup is created in the Backup folder. Always verify the result in-game.
save_credit:
Credit: original converter created by lotress.
Nexus Mods: https://www.nexusmods.com/stellarblade/users/12188623
Repository: https://github.com/lotress/CNSSaveConverter
cns_desc: Converts replacer outfits to Custom Nanosuit System and CNS outfits to a vanilla replacement. Source mods are never modified.
visible_name_placeholder: Derived from the file name if empty
multiple_mods_hint: With multiple mods, each one uses its file name.
cns_empty: There are no saved CNS conversions yet.
cns_fixer_desc: Scans IoStore mods, fixes duplicate Container_Id values, and reports resources with the same Package_Id. Compatible with direct installations and MO2-managed folders.
cns_fixer_hint: Analyze does not modify anything. Fix keeps the first Container_Id in each group, creates a .cnsidfixer.bak next to each modified file, and verifies the result. Package_Id values are never changed.
fix_duplicates_confirm: Only .utoc files with duplicate Container_Id values will be modified. A recoverable backup will be created before each change. Continue?
live_desc: Modify the game while it is running: field of view, movement speed, and jump strength. Requires UE4SS. The bridge does not touch saves, inventory, or progression.
live_no_game_hint: Configure the Stellar Blade path in Settings to install the bridge.
live_no_ue4ss_hint: UE4SS was not found in SB\Binaries\Win64\ue4ss. Install it separately; Stellar Tool does not distribute it.
live_installed_hint: Bridge installed. Open the game to connect; if it was already open, restart it so UE4SS loads the mod.
live_waiting_hint: Connected, waiting for a save to load.
live_fov_warning: Above 100°, the game may show unfinished or culled scenery; this is an experimental range.
live_multiplier_warning: High multipliers may cause animation clipping or streaming pop-in; the game was not designed for these values.
live_uninstall_confirm: The StellarToolLive folder will be removed from UE4SS mods. No other mod is touched. Values return to the game defaults after restarting it. Continue?
builder_enemy_tuning_hint: Independent settings for bosses and regular enemies.
